milestones.title: Issue offers to 3,150 contract teachers for the 2027 Year One intake
milestones.description: Wong announced October offer letters for medically cleared candidates, with appointments taking effect on 7 December.
milestones.progress_note: The reviewed announcement does not confirm delivery of every offer or teacher reporting for duty. The appointment date is distinct from October’s offer-letter schedule. No recruitment-completion percentage is inferred.

milestones.title: Seek appointments for 317 reserve teacher candidates
milestones.description: Wong said the ministry had asked the Education Service Commission to appoint 317 reserve candidates to fill vacancies.
milestones.progress_note: The September request is documented, but actual appointment of this specific group was not confirmed. Other earlier appointments and Sarawak’s overall fill rate do not measure this cohort’s completion.

methodology: Editorial records of dated public commitments, documented activities and delivery reports. Evidence-only activities and deliveries have no invented earlier promise URL or promise date. Additional research may extend the initial pass.
